sloka: पुत्रः किल स शक्रस्य वायसः पततां वरः ।धरान्तरगतः शीघ्रं पवनस्य गतौ समः ।। ५.३८.२८।।।।
transliteration: putraḥ kila sa śakrasya vāyasaḥ patatāṁ varaḥ ।dharāntaragataḥ śīghraṁ pavanasya gatau samaḥ ।। 5.38.28।।।।

translations.english: 'This crow was the best of birds. He was surely Indra's son who had covered a long distance with great speed and his speed was like the Windgod's.
